items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: unattended_answer on exactly the three allowlisted gates; validator rejects it on denylisted, locked, hard-stop and non-orchestrator-approve gates; resolver reports it only under unattended; test/changelog cataloged with COVERED_PHASES tuple and JSON together; gate_catalog.md regenerated; D6 consumer list produced with a disposition per file.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: unattended_answer_for fails closed on an unvalidated ineligible gate; read_run_config_autonomy returns None on missing, corrupt or non-string values so nothing silently becomes unattended.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No gate gains an auto-approve path: should_stop is unchanged, constitution and hard-stop gates cannot carry an answer, override refusal for unattended in phase_gate is untouched.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Allowlist and denylist pinned literally by id in the test; validator parametrized over each ineligible shape; CLI tests via main() and the orchestrator CLI via subprocess.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra dict lookup per resolved gate.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New logic in gate_unattended.py keeps gate_policy.py under 300 lines; gate_catalog_render.py gets a 2-line note; grandfathered changelog and deploy SKILL.md edits are net-zero or smaller.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer gate_catalog.json vs consumers validate_catalog, renderer and resolver CLI exercised together by the catalog, doc-sync and CLI tests; run_config autonomy writer (CLI) vs schema enum covered by test_autonomy_unattended.
